		function buildTimelineStickyHeader($container) {
			var $section = $container.siblings('.timeline-header');
			var $stickyHeader = $section.find('.timeline-sticky-header');
			var $items = $container.find('.timeline-item');

			if (!$stickyHeader.length || !$items.length) {
				return;
			}

			$stickyHeader.empty();

			$items.each(function(index) {
				var $item = $(this);
				var label = $.trim($item.find('h3.et_pb_module_header').text());

				if (!label) {
					label = 'Item ' + (index + 1);
				}

				$stickyHeader.append(
					$('<a/>', {
						href: '#',
						'class': 'timeline-sticky-link',
						'data-timeline-index': index,
						text: label,
						'aria-label': 'Go to ' + label
					})
				);
			});
		}

		function updateTimeline() {
			var viewportCenter = viewportHeight / 2;

			$('.timeline-container').each(function() {
				var $container = $(this);
                var $timelineTrack = $container.find('.timeline-track');
				var $timelineLogo = $container.find('.timeline-logo');
				var containerRect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
				var logoTopSpace = Math.max(0, viewportCenter - containerRect.top);
				var containerHeight = $container.outerHeight() || 0;
				var $items = $container.find('.timeline-item');
				var activeAnchorIndex = -1;
                var logoHeight = $timelineLogo.outerHeight() || 0;

				if (logoTopSpace >= containerHeight - logoHeight/2 && containerHeight > 0) {
                    logoTopSpace = containerHeight - logoHeight/2;
					$timelineLogo.removeClass('fixed').addClass('finish');
				} else if (logoTopSpace > 0) {
					$timelineLogo.addClass('fixed').removeClass('finish');
				} else {
					$timelineLogo.removeClass('fixed finish');
				}
				// $timelineLogo.css('transform', 'translateY(' + logoTopSpace + 'px)');
                $timelineTrack.find('.et_pb_code_inner').css('height', logoTopSpace + 'px');

					var itemRect = this.getBoundingClientRect();

				{ scrollTop: Math.max(0, ($targetItem.offset().top || 0) - viewportHeight/2 - ($timelineLogo.outerHeight() || 0)/4) },
				450,
				updateTimeline
			);
		});

		});
